articles.headline: Strong earthquake in Taiwan disrupts transport and semiconductor logistics
articles.summary: A strong earthquake in Taiwan disrupted rail services and caused temporary logistics delays affecting semiconductor shipments.
articles.body: A strong earthquake struck Taiwan on Thursday. Authorities reported temporary rail suspensions and logistics delays in several industrial areas. Semiconductor shipments were delayed as transport networks were inspected. The article does not confirm permanent factory damage or long-term production shutdowns.

articles.headline: US tightens export controls on advanced AI chips to China
articles.summary: The United States announced tighter restrictions on exports of advanced AI chips and related semiconductor technology to China.
articles.body: The United States government announced tighter export controls covering advanced artificial intelligence chips and selected semiconductor technology shipments to China. The restrictions apply to high-performance accelerators used in AI computing. NVIDIA was explicitly named as a company affected by the new controls. The measures take effect immediately.

articles.headline: Major AWS outage disrupts cloud services across the United States
articles.summary: Amazon Web Services reported a major cloud outage affecting customers across multiple US regions.
articles.body: Amazon Web Services reported a major cloud service outage affecting multiple customers in the United States. AWS said several cloud services experienced elevated error rates and network disruptions. Engineers were working to restore normal operations. Amazon confirmed the incident on its service status page.

articles.headline: Tesla temporarily halts production at Shanghai factory
articles.summary: Tesla temporarily halted vehicle production at its Shanghai plant following an operational disruption.
articles.body: Tesla temporarily halted vehicle production at its Shanghai factory after an operational disruption affected assembly activity. The company said production would resume after inspections were completed. The shutdown affects Tesla's vehicle assembly operations in China.

articles.headline: Federal Reserve cuts benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points
articles.summary: The Federal Reserve reduced its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points following its policy meeting.
articles.body: The Federal Reserve announced a 25 basis point reduction in its benchmark interest rate after its latest policy meeting. The central bank said the decision reflected changes in inflation and economic conditions. The new target range takes effect immediately.
